_comment: One entry per project. kind: core | homebrew | tool. asset: glob of the release file to offer (default: the first .zip, else .bin, never a 'debug' one). web: a page to open instead of a download. upstream: the repo this one is a fork of (its version is shown next to it). data: 'own' = needs the original game's files, 'free' = needs game files that are free to download. versions.json is written by .github/workflows/versions.yml.

desc.en: The firmware that runs everything in this catalog from the SD card.
desc.es: El firmware que ejecuta todo lo de este catálogo desde la tarjeta SD.
